ModMetaData.name: Automatic Apparel Manager
ModMetaData.author: tekmojo
ModMetaData.description: Create area-based work outfit and personal protective equipment (PPE) rules. Colonists equip required gear before qualifying work, use a configurable follow-up task buffer, return through an optional locker room, and restore their exact saved clothing. Includes live worker status, pause/recall controls, hauling and wandering permissions, child access, locker restocking, managed-apparel storage filters, saved-owner protection, and generic support for vanilla or modded apparel.
